dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Relatively smooth and symmetrical lateral margins with a slight outward convexity at the mid-section.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform dark slate-grey across the visible dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Minimal; the surface exhibits a homogenous dark tone with no distinct dark-pixel clusters.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A singular high-intensity white specular highlight or mark is visible immediately anterior to the blowhole.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Multiple shallow, rhythmic vertical indentations (fetal folds) are visible as subtle shadow-casting lines across the dorsal mid-section.

other_distinctive_markers: The presence of distinct, parallel vertical creasing across the dorsal width.
